claims.claim: Tesla stopped supplying Solar Roof tiles in August after installing roughly three thousand systems over seven years.
claims.episode_span: Tesla stopped supplying Solar Roof tiles in August and told certified installers later shipments would be conventional panels instead. The company installed roughly three thousand Solar Roof systems on U.S. homes over seven years, with weekly installs peaking at twenty-one to thirty-two.
claims.source_title: Tesla's Solar Roof exit strands installers with six-figure losses
claims.supporting_quote: Tesla stopped supplying Solar Roof tiles in August and informed certified installers that later shipments would consist of conventional solar panels instead.

claims.claim: A wrecked Model 3 accepted a charge and displayed remaining time on the screen despite heavy damage.
claims.episode_span: A man plugged a Tesla charger into a demolished Model 3 after a crash and the port light blinked to indicate readiness. The infotainment screen showed the charge starting and displayed remaining time.
claims.source_title: Man Gets Wrecked Tesla In The Shop, Then Plugs It In: 'I Wouldn't Do That'
claims.supporting_quote: Then Dr. Auto plugs the NACS cable into the destroyed Tesla . It makes a noise that indicates the cable is properly plugged in and charging. The infotainment display reads "starting to charge" and shows how long it will take to charge.
